{
  "diagnosis": "Observed defects: terrain lacks strategic relief, uniform meadow texture, insufficient visual hierarchy, no broad asymmetric landforms, and no terrain-to-structure continuity. No visible gaps or floating geometry, but no legible ground identity.",
  "design_intent": "Introduce 2-3 broad asymmetric hills/basins with natural strata, varied meadow microdetail, warm earth-toned soil, and exposed rock to establish a readable, layered, non-repeating terrain foundation. Preserve city pad and border.",
